section_summary.extract_value: This section details the results of a single study. It describes data screening procedures, including handling missing data and outliers, and combining data from MTurk and college participants after finding no significant differences. The section references Table 1 for means, standard deviations, and intercorrelations of study variables. The main focus is on two regression-based moderation analyses testing self-compassion as a moderator for the relationship between body comparison/appearance self-worth and body appreciation, controlling for BMI and age. The results of these moderation analyses, including simple slopes and Johnson-Neyman technique findings, are discussed.
